blocks.text: We are in a fast and moving period of time. So many events are happening that one can hardly keep track on a scale that has never been recorded before! But seemingly the world is sound asleep and know not the hour of judgement that has truly started on the earth. And Jesus spoke why in Luke 21:34. Also He said in verse 35, “For as a snare shall it come upon the face of the whole earth.” And in verse 36 He reveals how the elect will escape it. Be alert and keep watching for Jesus cometh soon! In my recent letters we described about the events that are taking place in the heavens. They are giving warnings of the age closing and great events taking place; almost unbelievable lie just ahead. The sun and the moon are giving many warnings through eclipses in our age. They also establish the beginning and ending of the Great Tribulation and of the coming judgements. (Matt. 24:29 – Isa. 13:10 – Rev. 6:12-13) They serve as a signal of ominous things to come. It is certainly bringing things to a head. But right now I would like to go to a quote from Neal Frisby who has a wonderful letter of great value for the elect.

“What an era to be living in, what a significant generation! It is the one Jesus told us to watch for His soon return! Prophetic events are breaking forth worldwide! The earth is breaking up little by little and piece by piece! The tectonic plates under the earth are moving and fiery plates under the sea are widening! All of this is a warning God is trying to tell us that it is soon time to get off of this planet! – And we will, via the translation! Earthquakes are a sign for men to repent, that the age is ending and Jesus’ return is near! Plus the significance of quakes are actually preaching the Great Day of the Lord is closing in! – They are a sign! – Man’s last chance for repentance! All of this is leading to the world’s mightiest quake wherein the cities of the nations fell. (Rev. 16:19) – “Truly a sign for the elect to prepare!”

“The world is apprehensive every day because they do not know what the future holds, nor how to believe for the comfort of the spirit!” – “The world sees the terrifying weapons of man, the signs in the heavens and earth, more crime waves, murders, wars and upheavals! It portends a message of fear, anxiety, and perplexity to the masses! – It is a definite sign the shadow of the end is upon the age!” (Luke 21:25) “But to the people of God it means joy because redemption and translation is near!”

No matter what kind of problems the elect is confronted with or how perilous the future seems, God is definitely standing with them more than ever before! Here are Scriptures of encouragement. “God has not given us the spirit of fear, but of power, love and a sound mind!” (II Tim. 1:7) – “The beginning of your miracle is within you!” (Luke 17:21) “Believe within yourself, strength will be released!” – “Say God’s abundance and peace is within me, fear will depart! – The key is absolute confident faith in the right way of thinking!” – “As a man thinketh in his heart, so is he!” (Prov. 23:7) – John 14:27, “Jesus positively said, His peace is left with you completely! – Let not your heart be troubled, neither be afraid!” – “An absolute commandment! – Don’t be dismayed, but full of courage!” (Josh. 1:9) – “Trust in the Lord with all thine heart (Prov. 3:5) also reveals don’t let human reasoning frustrate you.” – Ps. 46:1, “God is our refuge and strength, a very ‘present’ help in trouble. – And by prophecy there will be some crises, jolts, and ominous events, storms and nature will be erratic. But the Lord will comfort His people until they are safely home with Him!” “According to the evidential signs and the many prophecies fulfilling we know we should see this Scripture fulfilled in our time.” – I Thess. 4:16-17, “For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of God: and the dead in Christ shall rise first: Then we which are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air: and so shall we ever be with the Lord.”

“The Bible says, cast not away your confidence therefore. And we can see how important our faith is concerning the Lord’s promises! For with the heart man believeth unto righteousness, and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation!” (Rom. 10:9-10) “How great is the Christian’s hope above all other false religions which can deliver nothing! But the Christian has the real evidence; God’s Word!” – “What a soul-stirring time this is; let us pray for the salvation and harvest of many souls! – No value can be put on a message such as this but all should do their utmost to help this ministry to work as quick as possible to bring in souls and to witness to as many as He provides that the age is ending!” (End quote.)

Just a reminder that we now have three wonderful Special Writing Books out, Volume One, Volume Two and Volume Three. – This month I am releasing two Special Writings called “Faith and Encouragement” and “Whosoever Will Let Him Receive” as well as a dynamic DVD called “The Impact!” (See offer below.) – Brother Frisby’s partners have truly been amazing in helping us to publish this vital message. Those that receive the message freely are truly thankful. May the Lord richly bless and prosper each person in their decisions in the days ahead.
